  fl init [--yes]
  fl investigate --ci-log <file> --repo <directory> [...]
  fl investigate git ...
  fl investigate turns ...
  fl verify <proof-bundle-directory> [--expect-root <sha256:...>]
  fl witness propose|review|approve|freeze ...
